fields.description: Select the Social Login Key used for OIDC authentication
fields.label: Social Login Key

fields.description: Identity provider type: Keycloak (uses 'sub') or Entra ID (uses 'oid' + 'tid')
fields.label: Identity Provider Type

fields.description: Hours after sign-in at which a session ends, however active it is. A change applies to new sessions only. It cannot exceed sso_session_max_hours_limit in the site config, 12 if not set.
fields.label: Session Max Lifetime (Hours)

fields.description: Redirect to Identity Provider end_session_endpoint upon Frappe logout
fields.label: Enable Single Logout (SLO)

fields.description: Months of inactivity before including user in the monthly deprovisioning report
fields.label: Inactivity Threshold (Months)

fields.description: Enable reconciliation job to verify user status in IdP
fields.label: Enable Reconciliation

fields.description: Comma-separated email addresses to notify on refused logins, bindings, or anomalies
fields.label: Admin Notification Emails

fields.description: How often the reconciliation also runs by itself. The credential it needs is in the site config.
fields.label: Reconciliation Schedule
fields.options:
By Hand
Every 15 Minutes
Hourly
Daily

fields.description: A run that would disable a larger share of the users changes nothing and notifies the addresses below: a wrong realm answers that every user is gone.
fields.label: Stop If More Than (%) Would Be Disabled
